Schedule no. RS-23-0877 to the Master Rental Agreement · standard terms overleaf

**1** This rental agreement is entered into between **Sample Office Equipment Finance (Pty) Ltd** (**sample**) ("the Lessor") and **Marula Office Supplies (Pty) Ltd** ("the Renter") on the standard terms overleaf, which form part of this schedule.

# STANDARD TERMS OF RENTAL

## 1. DEFINITIONS

**1.1** "Equipment" means the goods described in the rental schedule, including all parts, accessories and replacements.
**1.2** "Rental" means the monthly amount stated in the rental schedule, as escalated in terms of clause 6.2.

## 2. RENTAL

**2.1** The Lessor rents the Equipment to the Renter for the rental period on these terms. Each rental schedule constitutes a separate agreement.

## 3. DELIVERY AND ACCEPTANCE

**3.1** The Renter selected the Equipment and its supplier and shall sign a delivery and acceptance certificate on delivery. The Lessor gives no warranty as to the Equipment's fitness for purpose.

## 4. OWNERSHIP

**4.1** Ownership of the Equipment remains with the Lessor at all times. The Renter shall not sell, pledge, sublet or remove the Equipment from the installation address without the Lessor's written consent.
**4.2** The Renter shall notify the landlord of the installation premises in writing that the Equipment belongs to the Lessor, and shall provide the Lessor with a copy of the notice.

## 5. USE AND MAINTENANCE

**5.1** The Renter shall use the Equipment carefully, in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions, and shall have it maintained only by the Lessor's approved service provider.

## 6. RENTAL PAYMENTS

**6.1** The Rental is payable monthly in advance by debit order. The Renter's obligation to pay is not affected by any defect in or failure of the Equipment.
**6.2** The rental escalates by 10% on each anniversary of the commencement date.
**6.3** Overdue amounts bear interest at the maximum rate permitted by law.

## 7. INSURANCE AND RISK

**7.1** Risk in the Equipment passes to the Renter on delivery. The Renter shall insure the Equipment for its full replacement value, noting the Lessor's interest.

## 8. CESSION

**8.1** The Lessor may cede its rights under this agreement to a financier without notice to the Renter. The Renter shall not raise against the cessionary any defence it has against the Lessor.

# **STANDARD TERMS OF RENTAL (CONTINUED)**

**9. BREACH**
**9.1** If the Renter fails to pay any amount on due date or breaches any other term and fails to remedy it within 7 (seven) days of written notice, the Lessor may claim immediate payment of all amounts owing and the Rental for the unexpired rental period, or cancel this agreement, repossess the Equipment and claim damages.

**10. CERTIFICATE OF BALANCE**
**10.1** A certificate signed by any manager of the Lessor stating the amount owing shall be prima facie proof of that amount.

**11. EARLY SETTLEMENT**
**11.1** The Renter may settle this agreement before the end of the initial period by paying the Rental for the unexpired period plus a settlement fee quoted by the Lessor.

**12. TERMINATION**
**12.1** The Renter may not terminate during the initial period except as set out below.
**12.2** The Renter may terminate this agreement by giving three months' written notice before the end of the initial period.

**12.3** If no such notice is given, this agreement continues month to month on the same terms.

**12.4** On termination the Renter shall return the Equipment, at its cost and in good working order, to an address nominated by the Lessor.

**13. CONSUMER PROTECTION**
**13.1** The Renter warrants that it is a juristic person whose asset value or annual turnover exceeds the threshold determined under the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008.

**14. GENERAL**
**14.1** These terms and the rental schedule are the whole agreement. No variation, relaxation or cancellation is valid unless in writing and signed by the Lessor.
**14.2** The Renter chooses the installation address as its domicilium citandi et executandi and consents to the jurisdiction of the Magistrate's Court.
**14.3** The Renter consents to the Lessor obtaining and sharing its credit information with registered credit bureaus.
